question.shortAnswer: Harbor — CNCF private registry: wget installer, harbor.yml (hostname, TLS, password), `./install.sh --with-trivy`. docker login + tag harbor.example.com/project/image + push. Projects + RBAC, Trivy scan, replication.
question.idealAnswer: Harbor wraps OCI Distribution: RBAC, projects, Trivy scanning, Notary/Cosign signing, replication, retention, OIDC/LDAP. Install: harbor-online-installer v2.11, harbor.yml hostname/https/certs/password, install.sh --with-trivy (~10 containers). Push: docker login, tag harbor.example.com/myproject/myapp:1.0, push. Projects: private/public, roles. Scan on push, prevent HIGH+. Replication: pull-through Docker Hub, hub-spoke multi-region. Retention + GC. HA: Helm on K8s, S3 storage. Ошибки: no TLS; no retention (disk full); backup postgres+blobs; scanning disabled.
